prompt:

Header text verbatim: "skidåkning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "skiing".
Scene: Adult woman cross-country skiing on groomed snowy forest trail, two skis on parallel tracks, poles naturally planted.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "skidåkning = skiing; the activity of moving on skis.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon tycker om skidåkning.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
